title: Robust fine-tuning of zero-shot models (WiSE-FT)
mechanism: Linearly interpolate pretrained and fine-tuned weights; large OOD gains at small or no ID cost.
adaptation: Post hoc, zero training: interpolate encoder only between ImageNet and fine-tuned weights (a in 0.3..0.9), keep the decoder, recompute BN stats on train. Also interpolate house and PF checkpoints of the same seed.
evidence: +4 to 6 pp under distribution shift on ImageNet shifts, +2 to 23 pp on six other shifts, +0.8 to 3.3 pp on seven transfer datasets (CLIP classification).
min_experiment: Existing checkpoints house s5-9, PF s5-9: pick a on val relF1@2, then read E1 at an opening. Kill if no a beats both endpoints by +0.005 val relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: Post hoc on existing checkpoints: encoder theta = (1-a) ImageNet + a fine-tuned, a in 0.3 to 0.9, decoder kept, BN recomputed on train; also house-to-PF interpolation of the same seed and LiNeS (arxiv:2410.17146) depth scaling. Choose a on val/CV only.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: interpolated house s5-9 and PF s5-9. Baseline: the endpoints. Metric: val relF1@2 and F51 crack AP, then E1 at an opening. Kill: no coefficient beats both endpoints on val by +0.005 relF1@2.
